value.rationale: A natural four-dimensional extremal plane-cubic system from a widely stated geometric irreducibility problem gets its entire rational parameter stratification by geometric smoothness, local singularity type, split branch arithmetic and rational point counts, uniformly in q. The exact norm divisor and arithmetic mod-three behavior distinguish the previously indistinguishable q³+q²+q+1 members, making this a useful structural strengthening rather than a table recomputation.
